analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI at 54.9 continues in the neutral zone, rising from 49.0 five days ago but lacking further upward momentum after exiting oversold. MACD histogram at 22835.3327 has worsened compared to 33012.2968 five days ago. ADX at 14.5 indicates continued trend weakening, entering a non-trending phase. Despite closing positive for five consecutive days, the pattern strengthens into a sideways range as it stays below the 20-day high. Volatility is high with ATR at 7.26%, but the lack of trend makes directional judgment difficult.
